title: The demo task
statement: Put together a cart with: exactly 2 Court Classic shoes (White, size 9); exactly 2 DISTINCT bottles from this set: Hiker Water Bottle (Navy, 500ml), Hiker Water Bottle (Steel, 750ml), Thermo Flask (Black, 500ml); and a cart total of at most $200.00. Other items are allowed - only these constraints are checked.
